summary: Verified both fixes for iter 2026-09-11 engagement nudge event mislabeling + gate resume regression. Backend pytest 3/3 passing. Live POST /api/aurem-dev/onboarding/nudge/shown with trigger=post_skip returns 200 {ok:true,capped:false}. DB verification (funnel_events collection) shows historic pre-fix events labelled post_scan_nudge_shown right after repo_connect_gate_skipped (2026-09-09 rows) and new post-fix events (2026-09-11 rows from this run) correctly labelled post_skip_nudge_shown. Frontend regression check confirmed: fresh zero-install / zero-project user (fresh-p2-empty-0903@aurem.dev, reset via mongo $unset) sees the mandatory gate wizard with 'Install Aurem for your repos' + 'Continue with GitHub App' CTA and 'Skip for now' link exactly as before — asGate branch of the appInstalls memo does NOT regress the brand-new-user path. Skip flow still fires POST /onboarding/repo-connect-gate/skip then POST /onboarding/nudge/shown {trigger:post_skip,project_id:null}, and the ORA Guide mascot post-skip nudge renders bottom-right. Real GitHub OAuth 'returning user with prior install' flow could not be simulated (no OAuth in sandbox) — code path inspection of NewUserWizard.jsx L110-117 confirms the asGate=true branch now returns ghConnectStatus.installations unfiltered instead of freshInstallIds-filtered, so a returning user with a prior installation will now hit appPickerActive=true and skip the initial install CTA — logic is correct by inspection.
critical_code_review_comments: NewUserWizard.jsx is 1326 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting the appInstalls/appPickerActive/repos memo cluster + the render-time repo-picker JSX into a subcomponent for readability, since the same file also owns the Skip funnel emit, the AddProjectWizard reuse contract, and the ORA guide-mascot dispatch. Not blocking this round's fix.

signup_guards.emit_engagement_nudge_shown / _task_sent — the fix is correct and unit-tested, but recommend adding an allowlist assert (trigger in {'post_scan','post_skip'}) so a future typo (e.g. trigger='postskip') doesn't silently mint a garbage event_type like 'postskip_nudge_shown' downstream.
test_credentials: Preview fresh-p2-empty-0903@aurem.dev / FreshEmpty2026! (reset via $unset on repo_connect_gate_skipped/post_skip_nudge_count/pending_nudge/last_real_task_message_at during this run — will need re-reset if reused for the same brand-new-user scenario).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing preview accounts. Ran $unset on 4 fields on fresh-p2-empty-0903 dev_users row to restore brand-new-user state for the gate regression check; the user now again has repo_connect_gate_skipped=True + pending_nudge{trigger:post_skip} from this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes verified. The DB proof is in funnel_events: query {user_id:'612673b71f2e424d9bc711f26eec195e'} sorted by created_at shows pre-fix (2026-09-09) had 'post_scan_nudge_shown' following 'repo_connect_gate_skipped'; post-fix rows (2026-09-11 01:17-01:19) now correctly log 'post_skip_nudge_shown'. Real GitHub OAuth 'returning user with prior installation but zero projects -> gate should skip to repo picker' cannot be simulated in this env — flagged as inspection-only, code diff in NewUserWizard.jsx L110-117 is correct.
rca of the issue: Fix 1 RCA: services/signup_guards.emit_engagement_nudge_shown()/_task_sent() previously hardcoded event_type='post_scan_nudge_shown'/'post_scan_nudge_task_sent' regardless of trigger argument. Fix now derives event_type=f'{trigger}_nudge_shown', matching the trigger. Fix 2 RCA: NewUserWizard.jsx appInstalls memo unconditionally filtered installations via freshInstallIds (session-scoped fresh installs) — intended for AddProjectWizard (asGate=false) reuse case, but leaked into asGate=true path, causing returning users with prior installations but zero projects to see the initial Install CTA again. Fix: when asGate is true, return unfiltered ghConnectStatus.installations. Safe because asGate implies zero existing projects, so no cross-project leak risk.
